description: Independent MAI Commercial Appraisal or Uniform Residential Appraisal Report (Form 1004) certifying the subject property's market collateral value and stabilized Net Operating Income (NOI). Where to read: Identified by "Appraisal Report", "MAI Certification", or "Uniform Residential Appraisal Report (Form 1004)" cover page and Executive Valuation Summary table. Distinguish from: Do NOT confuse with a Credit Agreement (`cre-credit-agreement`) or Closing Disclosure (`trid-closing-disclosure`); an appraisal establishes collateral valuation (`appraised_value`) but never sets binding loan terms or fees.

issuer.description: Independent MAI appraisal firm or certified real estate appraiser.

appraised_value.description: Certified market appraised value of the real estate collateral. Where to read: Executive Summary / Reconciliation & Final Value Conclusion table. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract insurable replacement cost, land-only value, or tax assessment value.

property_address.description: Full street address, city, state, and postal code of the appraised subject property. Where to read: Cover page and Property Identification block. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the appraisal firm's office address or comparable sale addresses.

net_operating_income.description: Appraiser's projected stabilized annual Net Operating Income (NOI). Where to read: Income Capitalization Approach / Direct Capitalization Pro Forma table. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract Potential Gross Income (PGI) or post-debt-service cash flow.

currency.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code for the valuation (e.g. USD). Where to read: Executive Summary table header or monetary notation. Distinguish from: Normalize '$' to 'USD'.

valuation_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) as of which the appraised market value applies. Where to read: Letter of Transmittal and Executive Summary ('Effective Date of Appraisal'). Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the report signature/transmittal date if distinct from the effective valuation date.
